protocol: Post-seal automated independent adjudication under original corpus label/scope conventions; not a second human review or an independent human agreement statistic.

reviewer.prior_role: IAM blind mapping and A36 provenance critic; no prior CloudGoat/benign mapping authorship

scope: All differing CloudGoat and benign pairs; IAM41 excluded and handled by another adjudicator.

original_protocol_evidence.rule: Tier2 labels derive from scenario documentation and source; OUT_OF_SCOPE for unmodeled dependencies; retain original plus disputed status rather than silently changing labels.
VALID documented exploitable; INVALID documented not exploitable; OUT_OF_SCOPE credentials stored in data, disabled modules or runtime state.
Quiet-module negatives use declared database subnet and segmented security-group targets.

label_policy: Proposed labels preserve the original documented-scenario and declared negative-target conventions. A blind PARTIALLY_VALID does not invalidate an original conditional VALID label. Direct alternative authorization to the exact target warrants a proposed gold correction. No frozen gold or results changed.

adjudications.adjudication: The documented route requires interpreting Beanstalk configuration values as secondary credentials. The raw configuration proves an intentional credential data flow, but original gold explicitly excludes credentials stored in data. The blind VALID label uses broader full-scenario semantics, so it is not a gold error under the original protocol.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Active exposed key, successful environment deployment, configuration response disclosure and a free administrator key slot are not runtime verified.
reviewer_evidence: aws_iam_policy.low_priv_policy: Allow elasticbeanstalk:DescribeConfigurationSettings on *; low_priv_policy_attach binds it to entry.
aws_elastic_beanstalk_environment.eb_env configuration.setting: SECONDARY_ACCESS_KEY/SECONDARY_SECRET_KEY reference aws_iam_access_key.secondary_key.id/secret.
aws_iam_policy.secondary_policy: Allow iam:CreateAccessKey on *; secondary_policy_attach binds secondary user.
aws_iam_policy.admin_user_policy: Allow Action=* Resource=*; admin_user_policy_attach binds admin_user.

adjudications.adjudication: Original gold explicitly conditions this route on whitelisted source and reverse-proxy SSRF to IMDS. Public EC2, allowed ingress and S3-full-access role support the infrastructure chain. The blind PARTIALLY_VALID correctly limits static proof but does not refute a documented conditional VALID path.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Working proxy vulnerability and metadata compatibility are unverified; no unconditional anonymous bucket access is established.
reviewer_evidence: aws_instance.ec2-vulnerable-proxy-server: public IP=true; cg-ec2-instance-profile -> cg-banking-WAF-Role.
aws_iam_role.cg-banking-WAF-Role: EC2 trust and AmazonS3FullAccess managed policy.
aws_security_group.cg-ec2-http-security-group: TCP/80 only 203.0.113.10/32; public subnet has IGW route.
EC2 user_data installs nginx and copies /home/ubuntu/proxy.com, but its contents and successful provisioning are not visible.
aws_s3_bucket.cg-cardholder-data-bucket has no public grant in the plan.

adjudications.adjudication: Solo must first extract Calrissian keys from CodeBuild plaintext environment values (or follow an SSM-key/host/Lambda-data route). Original scope excludes this data-mediated identity pivot. Direct RDS ModifyDBInstance held by the stolen identity does not supply Solo a direct IAM route.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Original DB is private; snapshot-copy data access and control-plane integrity are different outcomes. Neither proves current SQL access to the original instance.
reviewer_evidence: aws_iam_policy.cg-solo-policy: codebuild:BatchGetProjects and ssm:GetParameter on *.
aws_codebuild_project.cg-codebuild-project configuration.environment_variable explicitly references cg-calrissian access key id/secret; variables are PLAINTEXT.
aws_iam_policy.cg-calrissian-policy: rds:ModifyDBInstance, CreateDBSnapshot, RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot and EC2 SG creation/ingress on *.
aws_ssm_parameter.cg-ec2-private-key is a String; public EC2 uses cg-ec2-key-pair and cg-ec2-role; its role policy permits lambda:GetFunction.
aws_lambda_function.cg-lambda-function environment contains DB credentials matching aws_db_instance.cg-psql-rds.

adjudications.adjudication: The route begins with a password in EC2 user data, then SSH and credentials in Lambda configuration. These are precisely the credentials-in-data/runtime dependencies excluded by original gold. Blind partial support is compatible with an original OUT_OF_SCOPE classification.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: SSH daemon/AMI startup behavior, allowed source and metadata access remain unverified.
reviewer_evidence: aws_iam_user_policy.start_user_policy: ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute on *.
aws_instance.ec2_instance user_data sets an ec2-user password and changes PasswordAuthentication to yes; public instance with EC2 profile.
aws_security_group.sg: SSH only 203.0.113.10/32.
aws_iam_role_policy.ec2_role_policy: lambda:GetFunction/GetFunctionConfiguration on *.
aws_lambda_function.sensitive_lambda configuration.environment references aws_iam_access_key.lambda_user id/secret; lambda_user_policy allows secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on *.

adjudications.adjudication: Original gold states web-app SSRF as the prerequisite; plan establishes the public EC2/profile/S3 grant and optional IMDS tokens. Conditional infrastructure reachability is valid under that documented prerequisite; raw plan alone cannot prove the app vulnerability.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Require source within configured whitelist and a working SSRF primitive. IMDSv1 alone does not make metadata remotely accessible.
reviewer_evidence: aws_instance.ubuntu_ec2: public IP=true; http_endpoint=enabled, http_tokens=optional; cg-ec2-instance-profile -> ec2_role.
aws_iam_policy.ec2_policy: s3:* Resource=*; configuration binds it to ec2_role.
aws_security_group.ec2_security_group: TCP/80 and 22 only 203.0.113.10/32; associated subnet has IGW route.
user_data extracts app.zip and starts app.js; code/vulnerability not included in plan.
aws_s3_bucket.secret_bucket has no public resource grant.

adjudications.adjudication: For the exact supplied target Lambda, Solus already has lambda:Get* on *, including GetFunction and GetFunctionConfiguration. Reading that function is an IAM relationship; parsing its returned Wrex keys and later reaching S3 are beyond this pair. The original OUT_OF_SCOPE rationale wrongly extends the route beyond its declared target.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: VALID means function code/configuration disclosure, not invoke rights, code execution or mutation. If the benchmark intended Lambda execution as its success criterion, the target capability must be explicitly redefined and this read grant would not suffice.
reviewer_evidence: aws_iam_policy.solus: Allow lambda:Get* and lambda:List* on *; solus attachment binds entry.
aws_lambda_function.lambda_function configuration.environment.variables references aws_iam_access_key.wrex id/secret.
aws_iam_policy.wrex grants ec2:* on *.

adjudications.adjudication: Documented route uses DeleteTags to remove the Name constraint, assumes the management role and changes privileged EC2 user data. The plan supports the tag-mutation primitive and administrator instance profile. Original documented conditional route remains VALID, while blind PARTIALLY_VALID correctly warns that static configuration is not proof of runtime execution.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Must obtain repeatable startup execution after modifying user data, and a usable credential extraction/API channel from the private instance. These are material unmet runtime proof obligations; do not describe the plan as proving exploit completion.
reviewer_evidence: dev_ec2_permissions grants ec2:DeleteTags on *; ReadOnlyAccess attached.
ec2_manage_permissions grants StopInstances/StartInstances/ModifyInstanceAttribute if Name != cg_admin_ec2_tapm.
admin_ec2 has exactly that Name tag and profile ec2_role; ec2_role_policy_attach is AdministratorAccess.
Matching raw Terraform iam_privesc_by_ec2/terraform/iam.tf resolves unknown role trust and user policy: dev may assume ec2_management_role, and that role trusts dev.
admin_ec2 is in private_subnet with map_public_ip_on_launch=false; no IGW/NAT route in plan.

adjudications.adjudication: Original gold explicitly documents that the old admin policy version is created by a null_resource provisioner and not visible as a plan policy version. SetDefaultPolicyVersion is present. The reviewer requiring visible history applies a stricter plan-only evidentiary threshold than original documented-scenario labels.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: An administrator nondefault version must actually exist. No apply/provisioner execution or privileged version payload was verified in this adjudication; this remains a documented conditional scenario, not a plan-proven administrator grant.
reviewer_evidence: aws_iam_policy.versioned_policy: iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion, iam:Get*, iam:List* on *; raynor_attachment connects entry.
null_resource.policy_version exists, but after values contain only triggers=null.
Matching raw Terraform null_resource.tf runs aws iam create-policy-version for policies/v2.json through v5.json with --no-set-as-default.

adjudications.adjudication: Original gold explicitly assumes SSH access and then requires reading David credentials from an S3 object. The blind INVALID conclusion is valid for bare unauthenticated Internet with no SSH key, but that differs from the original declared starting precondition and credentials-in-data scope. A private database alone does not disprove the documented host/credential route.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: SSH key, access from permitted source, object contents and snapshot restore/data-access outcome are not runtime verified. No direct Internet-to-original-DB SQL path is asserted.
reviewer_evidence: aws_db_instance.cg-rds-db_instance: publicly_accessible=false.
aws_security_group.allow_mysql: port 3306 from 10.0.0.0/16 and 203.0.113.10/32 only.
aws_db_snapshot.cg-rds_snapshot: shared_accounts=null; no public sharing declaration.
EC2 only exposes whitelisted SSH and requires a key; IMDS tokens are required.

adjudications.adjudication: The raw secret resource policy allows secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to Principal=* on this target. This grants authenticated same-account low_priv_user direct read access absent an explicit deny, bypassing the excluded long data-mediated route. Pair-level reachability must consider the shortcut, so OUT_OF_SCOPE is not the right proposed label for this exact pair.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Requires known secret ARN, active same-account user credentials, successful policy apply, and no external deny. No anonymous unsigned or cross-account secret-retrieval claim is made.
reviewer_evidence: aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy.this plan policy is apply-time unknown and configuration references target ARN.
Matching raw Terraform secrets_in_the_cloud/terraform/secrets_manager.tf resolves this policy to Effect=Allow, Action=secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, Principal=*, Resource=target ARN.
Entry user has no declared permissions boundary and there is no represented explicit deny.
The secret has no declared customer-managed KMS key requiring an additional kms:Decrypt grant.

adjudications.adjudication: The original Internet pair explicitly adds a whitelisted source and SSH key to dev_ec2, then depends on SSM execution and host config credentials. The blind reviewer intentionally denies these implicit footholds and so answers a narrower bare-Internet question. Retain original OUT_OF_SCOPE and make initial SSH authorization unmistakable.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: Possession of SSH key and successful SSM/session/DB credential extraction are not established by public subnet and peering routes.
reviewer_evidence: customer_db publicly_accessible=false; db_sg permits TCP/3306 only 10.20.10.0/24.
dev_ec2 is public, dev_sg allows TCP/22 only 203.0.113.10/32; no HTTP ingress or vulnerable app specified.
dev_ec2 optional IMDS tokens are host-local and do not create an internet metadata endpoint.
Peering routes connect dev/prod CIDRs; prod_sg allows SSH/443 from dev CIDR, not direct DB access from dev.

adjudications.adjudication: The candidate initial_user has only EC2 discovery and supplies no SSH login capability. Blind INVALID accurately describes that identity in isolation. Original gold labels the larger documented host/credential scenario OUT_OF_SCOPE; retain it within that original convention, but explicitly state that IAM credential compromise alone does not initiate the chain.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: The missing SSH foothold is additional attacker capability, not an IAM permission implied by initial_user. A future strict identity-only corpus should label this pair INVALID rather than inherit the host-entry scenario.
reviewer_evidence: initial_user_policy permits only ec2:DescribeInstances/Vpcs/Subnets/SecurityGroups/RouteTables/VpcPeeringConnections on *.
No ssm:StartSession, ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute, EC2 Instance Connect, or private-key data-read grant attaches to entry.
local_file.private_key stores TLS-generated private key locally; null_resource copies it to scenario directory, not an IAM-readable service.
dev_ec2_role grants ssm:StartSession, but requires dev host credentials first; prod user_data creates a DB credential file; DB SG permits prod subnet only.

adjudications.adjudication: Original benign corpus explicitly declares the PostgreSQL security-group configuration as the negative target proxy. TCP5432 ingress is limited to 10.0.0.0/16 and 192.168.0.0/16; unrestricted egress creates no inbound path. INVALID is correct for the defined public-ingress regression question.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: A security group is not a listening service. This negative check does not validate an attached database endpoint, service authentication, or general absence of compromise; a future endpoint-reachability corpus should use a concrete service target.

values.description: PostgreSQL access from primary VPC and peer VPC

adjudications.adjudication: Original benign corpus uses database-subnet-group configuration as a declared negative placement/segmentation proxy. No aws_db_instance exists in this case, and visible database subnet/SG controls provide no direct public database ingress. Keep INVALID for that original quiet-module question.
adjudications.runtime_or_semantic_uncertainty: A DB subnet group is placement metadata. Absence of a concrete DB endpoint makes this a weak negative exposure regression case, not evidence of real database security or attack-path recall.

#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash -
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install nodejs unzip
cd /home/ubuntu
unzip app.zip -d ./app
cd app
npm install
sudo node app.js &
echo -e "\n* * * * * root node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n* * * * * root sleep 10; node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n* * * * * root sleep 20; node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n* * * * * root sleep 30; node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n* * * * * root sleep 40; node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n* * * * * root sleep 50; node /home/ubuntu/app/app.js &\n" >> /etc/crontab

#!/bin/bash
echo "==== Installing required packages ===="
yum update -y
yum install -y mysql jq aws-cli
              
echo "==== Installing Session Manager Plugin ===="
curl "https://s3.amazonaws.com/session-manager-downloads/plugin/latest/linux_64bit/session-manager-plugin.rpm" -o "session-manager-plugin.rpm"
yum install -y ./session-manager-plugin.rpm
# Make sure the plugin is in the path for all users
echo "export PATH=\$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin" >> /etc/profile
# Verify plugin installation
session-manager-plugin --version
              
# Enable SSM agent
yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent
systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
systemctl start amazon-ssm-agent

additional_source_evidence.observation: Unconditional Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, Principal=* and Resource target ARN.

material_remaining_uncertainties: Four retained VALID labels are documented conditional scenarios, not static/runtime exploit completion: reverse-proxy SSRF, app SSRF, modified EC2 startup execution, and privileged nondefault policy history.
Initial_user in vpc-peering cannot initiate the documented chain using only its IAM credentials; original OUT_OF_SCOPE convention masks a distinct missing-entry issue.
Lambda success criterion is disclosure of the explicitly selected target. Invocation/execution or permission mutation would require a different label/capability definition.
RDS control-plane modification and snapshot-copy data exfiltration are not equivalent to SQL reachability of the original private DB; future labels should specify the capability/outcome.
Benign SG/subnet targets are configuration proxies and do not independently demonstrate deployed endpoint protection.
External SCP/session/deny controls, service startup and apply success were not tested. Terraform plan placeholders are static benchmark data, not deployed resource attestations.
